title: The Waking Moment
subtitle: Amid a gloaming so frigid, even one's heart begins to tremble.

items.text: The Waking Moment

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Erick?!

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: 6 minutes and 37 seconds. Consistent with the awakening trend on the monitoring device.
She jots down several notes in the medical record book.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Lie back down and don't move. I'll get the medicine.
They are left alone in the hospital room.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You've been unconscious for days... They thought you would never wake up.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Cough, cough... I was planning to visit Valhalla.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: But Harald and those stinky old lice-ridden men grabbed my ears and said it wasn't my time yet.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: That’s a bit—
Sonetto lays her hand on Erick’s.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ...Erick, I'm sorry.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Those letters... they weren't actually written by Harald—
She freezes, then gently shakes her head.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: I understand.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Thank you for being honest, and for all you've done for me.
There is no longer doubt in her eyes.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: How are those grown-ups I injured? I... didn't mean to toss them so hard.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: They won't let me go back, will they?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Well...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The SPDM's management committee has submitted your transfer application...
What—?!
The bed frame begins to shake violently.
Two dusty little heads pop out from under the bed.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Hey, what are you two doing here?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I asked the instructor to bring them here. I thought it might help your condition...
But no one is paying any attention to her response.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Boss, you can't drop out!

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: I—I, I can bring out my precious Sharpodonty collection! The book I read said that staff and instructors always fall for that...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: ...Sancho, don't.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Your critter has been waiting in Ms. NewBabel’s cage for so long...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Besides—(cough, cough...)
She hunches over, covering her mouth as if choking on thick smoke.
Sancho opens his mouth to speak, but he can't say a word.
Her coughing... is like a small wooden hammer pounding on their hearts.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Really... there’s no hope left?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry...

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: ...If you leave, I'll never talk to anyone else ever again.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: (Sob...) I thought I finally found a real friend... but it turns out all this effort was for nothing.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: I knew it would end like this, yet I still planned so much with you...

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: "People delude themselves into passion in life, painting a portrait of themselves; but in the end, they are left with nothing but the portrait."

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: They were right... (Sob)
She lowers her head, her shoulders shaking. She wipes the tears and snot from her face.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Don't be like this, Eifer... The boss is hurting too.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: (Sob...) No, she isn't; if you ask me, we've all been deceived.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: What about the mountains of treasures? The monsters called "Emptiness" and "Vanity"? There's no such thing anywhere in the world.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: If there were, you would have taken us to see it for ourselves!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: You're so reckless, always getting us into trouble. Because of you, my semester badge got revoked.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: You don't actually have a ship or any of those thrilling adventures. You just have a silly little wooden sword!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: (Sob...) And what can you command with it? What can you cut with it?
She covers her eyes with her arms, but the tears keep falling and the snot keeps dripping.
"Drip, drip—"

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: I knew it all, everything—

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Even so, we still followed you around.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: But now, you don't care about us anymore (sob sob sob...)

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: The boss hasn't abandoned us—

She pushes away the tissue presented in Sancho’s hand.
She doesn’t even glimpse at Erick.
She runs off like a child soaked by the rain.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hey, hey, Eifer—!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Sorry...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: It's okay, boss... It's not your fault.
A nurse pushes in a medicine cart, followed by a familiar hat.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Look... I have to go too.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Get well soon, boss.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: (Cough, cough, cough)

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Wait...!
He too leaves.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Put out your hand.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Take a deep breath.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: There will be momentary pain in your wrist, but after 1 minute and 28 seconds, your arm will be completely numb.
TO BE CONTINUED…
